qualityFloor.failurePosture: hard structural envelope failures, zero marks, extreme underflow, provider transport failure, or token-limit failure may HOLD. qualityFloor.partialQualityVisibleTurnCeiling: ordinary PARTIAL returns immediately; a repairable native-voice PARTIAL gets one same-seat Gemini repaint, after which either the improved repaint or the exact original PARTIAL becomes visible

qualityFloor.interactiveSuccessLaw: first structurally admissible PASS ends the human turn; ordinary PARTIAL returns immediately; repairable native-voice PARTIAL gets one bounded same-seat repaint but never becomes a style-only frontier chase or HELD
qualityFloor.failedTurnObservability: Receipt frontier header, route metric and copied failure custody preserve every attempted model plus HTTP status; composer status remains task-oriented
qualityFloor.quotaCooldownLaw: model-scoped 429 persistence follows explicit Retry-After for the actual called seat with a 30-minute maximum; missing Retry-After defaults to 120 seconds; PerDay labels alone never authorize a Pacific-midnight lockout
qualityFloor.consumptionEvidenceLaw: request-local route/model attempts are observable; same-browser accumulation is partial coverage; arithmetic route capacity is not provider daily-total proof; provider_daily_total remains null without external provider evidence

providerPlanRecovery.quotaScopePosture: 429 is not provider exhaustion by status alone: structured model-scoped quota may fail over; shared/project-scoped quota may use one bounded RetryInfo/Retry-After recovery; unknown scope remains unknown

providerPlanRecovery.providerRetryWindowAuthority: when Gemini supplies Retry-After for HTTP 429, process-local cooldown follows that bounded window; exponential local quota backoff is reserved for 429 responses without a provider retry window
